critical_issues.description: Both email capture flows are functionally broken: the main signup handler always prevents submission and the exit popup only shows a toast, so users think they subscribed when nothing is actually stored. Submit to a real backend or the configured form endpoint, and only show success after the request completes with visible error handling on failure.

The page loads 25 third-party images without srcset, sizes, or picture sources, so small screens can still fetch oversized Unsplash and Pexels assets across a very long landing page. Generate responsive image variants, add srcset and sizes, avoid preloading desktop-sized media on mobile, and consider self-hosting optimized images.
